properties.script:
"""
XDR Workflow - Python Script Activity
Formats JSON output from a previous activity into a clean, readable
message for Slack, Webex, or other messaging apps.

SETUP:
  - Create an input variable:  raw_json (String) - mapped from previous activity output
  - Create output variables:   formatted_message (String) - plain text formatted
                                slack_message (String) - Slack markdown formatted
                                webex_message (String) - Webex markdown formatted
"""

import json
import sys


def flatten_dict(d, parent_key="", sep=" > "):
    """Flatten nested dicts into readable key paths."""
    items = []
    for k, v in d.items():
        new_key = f"{parent_key}{sep}{k}" if parent_key else k
        if isinstance(v, dict):
            items.extend(flatten_dict(v, new_key, sep).items())
        else:
            items.append((new_key, v))
    return dict(items)


def format_value(value):
    """Format a single value for display."""
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "Yes" if value else "No"
    if value is None:
        return "N/A"
    if isinstance(value, list):
        if not value:
            return "None"
        if all(isinstance(i, str) for i in value):
            return ", ".join(value)
        return f"({len(value)} items)"
    return str(value)


def format_plain(data, title="API Response"):
    """Format JSON data as plain readable text."""
    lines = []
    lines.append(f"{'=' * 50}")
    lines.append(f"  {title}")
    lines.append(f"{'=' * 50}")
    lines.append("")

    if isinstance(data, dict):
        # Handle Technitium-style responses with response/status keys
        status = data.get("status", "")
        response_data = data.get("response", data)

        if status:
            lines.append(f"Status: {status.upper()}")
            lines.append(f"{'-' * 40}")
            lines.append("")

        if isinstance(response_data, dict):
            flat = flatten_dict(response_data)
            # Calculate padding for alignment
            max_key_len = max((len(k) for k in flat.keys()), default=0)
            for key, value in flat.items():
                lines.append(f"  {key:<{max_key_len}}  :  {format_value(value)}")
        else:
            lines.append(f"  {format_value(response_data)}")

    elif isinstance(data, list):
        lines.append(f"Total Records: {len(data)}")
        lines.append(f"{'-' * 40}")
        for i, item in enumerate(data, 1):
            lines.append(f"\n  [{i}]")
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                flat = flatten_dict(item)
                max_key_len = max((len(k) for k in flat.keys()), default=0)
                for key, value in flat.items():
                    lines.append(
                        f"    {key:<{max_key_len}}  :  {format_value(value)}"
                    )
            else:
                lines.append(f"    {format_value(item)}")
    else:
        lines.append(f"  {format_value(data)}")

    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"{'=' * 50}")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def format_slack(data, title="API Response"):
    """Format JSON data as Slack mrkdwn."""
    lines = []
    lines.append(f"*{title}*")
    lines.append("")

    if isinstance(data, dict):
        status = data.get("status", "")
        response_data = data.get("response", data)

        if status:
            emoji = ":white_check_mark:" if status == "ok" else ":x:"
            lines.append(f"{emoji} *Status:* `{status}`")
            lines.append("")

        # Handle zone info if present
        if isinstance(response_data, dict):
            zone = response_data.get("zone", {})
            if zone and isinstance(zone, dict):
                zone_name = zone.get("name", "")
                zone_type = zone.get("type", "")
                if zone_name:
                    lines.append(f":globe_with_meridians: *Zone:* `{zone_name}`")
                if zone_type:
                    lines.append(f":label: *Type:* `{zone_type}`")
                lines.append("")

            # Handle records list
            records = response_data.get("records", [])
            if records:
                lines.append(f"*Records ({len(records)}):*")
                lines.append("```")
                # Table header
                lines.append(f"{'Name':<35} {'Type':<6} {'TTL':<8} {'Value'}")
                lines.append(f"{'-'*35} {'-'*6} {'-'*8} {'-'*20}")
                for rec in records:
                    name = rec.get("name", "N/A")
                    rtype = rec.get("type", "N/A")
                    ttl = str(rec.get("ttl", "N/A"))
                    rdata = rec.get("rData", {})
                    # Extract the most relevant rData value
                    value = (
                        rdata.get("ipAddress")
                        or rdata.get("cname")
                        or rdata.get("nameServer")
                        or rdata.get("exchange")
                        or rdata.get("text")
                        or rdata.get("ptrName")
                        or str(rdata)
                    )
                    disabled = rec.get("disabled", False)
                    flag = " [DISABLED]" if disabled else ""
                    lines.append(
                        f"{name:<35} {rtype:<6} {ttl:<8} {value}{flag}"
                    )
                lines.append("```")
            else:
                # Generic key-value display
                flat = flatten_dict(response_data)
                for key, value in flat.items():
                    lines.append(f"• *{key}:* `{format_value(value)}`")
        else:
            lines.append(f"`{format_value(response_data)}`")

    elif isinstance(data, list):
        lines.append(f"*Total: {len(data)} items*")
        lines.append("```")
        for i, item in enumerate(data, 1):
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                flat = flatten_dict(item)
                parts = [f"{k}: {format_value(v)}" for k, v in flat.items()]
                lines.append(f"[{i}] {' | '.join(parts)}")
            else:
                lines.append(f"[{i}] {format_value(item)}")
        lines.append("```")
    else:
        lines.append(f"`{format_value(data)}`")

    return "\n".join(lines)


def format_webex(data, title="API Response"):
    """Format JSON data as Webex markdown."""
    lines = []
    lines.append(f"## {title}")
    lines.append("")

    if isinstance(data, dict):
        status = data.get("status", "")
        response_data = data.get("response", data)

        if status:
            emoji = "✅" if status == "ok" else "❌"
            lines.append(f"{emoji} **Status:** `{status}`")
            lines.append("")

        if isinstance(response_data, dict):
            zone = response_data.get("zone", {})
            if zone and isinstance(zone, dict):
                zone_name = zone.get("name", "")
                zone_type = zone.get("type", "")
                if zone_name:
                    lines.append(f"🌐 **Zone:** `{zone_name}`")
                if zone_type:
                    lines.append(f"🏷️ **Type:** `{zone_type}`")
                lines.append("")

            records = response_data.get("records", [])
            if records:
                lines.append(f"**Records ({len(records)}):**")
                lines.append("")
                # Webex supports markdown tables
                lines.append("| Name | Type | TTL | Value | Status |")
                lines.append("|------|------|-----|-------|--------|")
                for rec in records:
                    name = rec.get("name", "N/A")
                    rtype = rec.get("type", "N/A")
                    ttl = str(rec.get("ttl", "N/A"))
                    rdata = rec.get("rData", {})
                    value = (
                        rdata.get("ipAddress")
                        or rdata.get("cname")
                        or rdata.get("nameServer")
                        or rdata.get("exchange")
                        or rdata.get("text")
                        or rdata.get("ptrName")
                        or str(rdata)
                    )
                    disabled = rec.get("disabled", False)
                    status_str = "❌ Disabled" if disabled else "✅ Active"
                    lines.append(
                        f"| `{name}` | {rtype} | {ttl} | `{value}` | {status_str} |"
                    )
            else:
                flat = flatten_dict(response_data)
                for key, value in flat.items():
                    lines.append(f"- **{key}:** `{format_value(value)}`")
        else:
            lines.append(f"`{format_value(response_data)}`")

    elif isinstance(data, list):
        lines.append(f"**Total: {len(data)} items**")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append("| # | Details |")
        lines.append("|---|---------|")
        for i, item in enumerate(data, 1):
            if isinstance(item, dict):
                flat = flatten_dict(item)
                parts = [f"{k}: {format_value(v)}" for k, v in flat.items()]
                lines.append(f"| {i} | {' \\| '.join(parts)} |")
            else:
                lines.append(f"| {i} | {format_value(item)} |")
    else:
        lines.append(f"`{format_value(data)}`")

    return "\n".join(lines)


# ============================================================
# MAIN - This is what runs in the XDR Python Script activity
# ============================================================

# Input: raw_json comes from a previous activity's output
# In XDR, map this to the HTTP Request activity's response body
raw_json = $activity.definition_activity_02TG641WE4TUD2LSpLLRWF6T4dNORivt6WK.output.response_body$  # noqa: F841 - XDR injects this variable

# Parse the JSON
try:
    data = json.loads(raw_json) if isinstance(raw_json, str) else raw_json
except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError) as e:
    data = {"error": f"Failed to parse JSON: {str(e)}", "raw": str(raw_json)}

# Set a title (customize as needed)
title = "Technitium DNS - Results"

# Generate all three formats
formatted_message = format_plain(data, title)
slack_message = format_slack(data, title)
webex_message = format_webex(data, title)

properties.description:
Posts a chat message in a Slack conversation. This atomic requires the following API scope: chat:write.

Target: Slack integration target or an HTTP Endpoint for "slack.com" with a path of "/api"

Account Key: None if using an integration-provided target, access token if using an HTTP Endpoint target

Steps:
[] Make sure at least one of the content variables was provided:
[]> If not, return an error
[] Build the authorization header and the request payload
[] Post the message
[] Check if the request was successful:
[]> If it wasn't, return an error
[] Extract the request status
[] Check if the request status was successful:
[]> If it was, attempt to extract the message data and set the output variables
[]> If it wasn't, return an error

More information about this API: https://api.slack.com/methods/chat.postMessage
